description: This Java class `TenantTraceSamplingHelper` provides helper methods to determine and apply tenant-specific tracing sampling priorities within a distributed tracing context. It interacts with span objects for tracing, retrieves tenant tracing configurations, and defines specific sampling modes.

classes.name: TenantTraceSamplingHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling tenant-specific trace sampling configuration, including retrieving and applying sampling priorities to tracing spans.

methods.name: getTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the optional trace sampling priority for the specified tenant object with authentication ID.

methods.name: applyTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Applies the sampling priority from tenant configuration to a given tracing span, and returns the applied priority if set.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Retrieves the tracing sampling mode for the specified tenant object, considering its tracing configuration.

methods.name: getSamplingPriority
methods.description: Converts a TracingSamplingMode to an optional integer priority (1 for ALL, 0 for NONE, empty otherwise).
